title: Immune determinants of the pre-metastatic niche

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Immune determinants of the pre-metastatic niche》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Primary tumors actively and specifically prime pre-metastatic niches (PMNs), the future sites of organotropic metastasis, preparing these distant microenvironments for disseminated tumor cell arrival.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Immune determinants of the pre-metastatic niche》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】While initial studies of the PMN focused on extracellular matrix alterations and stromal reprogramming, it is increasingly clear that the far-reaching effects of tumors are in great part achieved through systemic and local PMN immunosuppression.
